channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2012-1710 — Oracle Fusion Middleware
item.description: Threat Signal 72. Unspecified vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Forms Recognition component in Oracle Fusion Middleware allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality, integrity, and availability via Unknown vectors related to Designer.

item.title: CVE-2019-7193 — QNAP QTS
item.description: Threat Signal 73. QNAP QTS contains an improper input validation vulnerability allowing remote attackers to inject code on the system.

item.title: CVE-2016-2386 — SAP NetWeaver
item.description: Threat Signal 74. SQL injection vulnerability in the UDDI server in SAP NetWeaver J2EE Engine 7.40 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary SQL commands via unspecified vectors.

item.title: CVE-2018-6065 — Google Chromium V8
item.description: Threat Signal 70. Google Chromium V8 Engine contains an integer overflow vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to potentially exploit heap corruption via a crafted HTML page. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

item.title: CVE-2014-4148 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 70. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows kernel-mode driver improperly handles TrueType fonts.

item.title: CVE-2018-19949 — QNAP Network Attached Storage (NAS)
item.description: Threat Signal 75. A command injection vulnerability affecting QNAP NAS File Station could allow remote attackers to run commands.

item.title: CVE-2016-7256 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 71. A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows font library improperly handles specially crafted embedded fonts. An attacker who successfully exploits this vulnerability could take control of the affected system.

item.title: CVE-2017-8543 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Microsoft Windows allows an attacker to take control of the affected system when Windows Search fails to handle objects in memory.

item.title: CVE-2016-4657 — Apple iOS
item.description: Threat Signal 71. Apple iOS WebKit contains a memory corruption vulnerability that allows attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial-of-service (DoS) via a crafted web site. This vulnerability could impact HTML parsers that use WebKit, including but not limited to Apple Safari and non-Apple products which rely on WebKit for HTML processing.

item.title: CVE-2017-6862 — NETGEAR Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

item.description: Threat Signal 72. Moxilla Firefox allows remote attackers to bypass the Same Origin Policy to read arbitrary files or gain privileges.

item.title: CVE-2015-8651 — Adobe Flash Player
